directional_predictions.presence_memory: The symmetric formation-memory treatment should increase short-horizon renewal and temporal clustering if local memory is a causal persistence channel.
directional_predictions.destination_choice: Neighbor restriction should increase adjacent activation and spatial autocorrelation if geographic diffusion is a causal reproduction channel.
directional_predictions.interaction: A positive interaction is evidence that persistence and adjacency jointly sustain local reproduction; it is not a general-theory claim without synthetic recovery and cross-case replication.

falsifiers: neither treatment changes its predeclared primary estimand beyond the simulation uncertainty interval
the memory treatment changes only event totals but not renewal or temporal clustering
neighbor restriction changes movement but not adjacent activation or Moran's I
parent-attributed reproduction cannot be recovered from synthetic truth
any cell has model-source drift during execution or lacks a content-addressed manifest
supply conservation fails under either treatment
acceptance_gate: Do not fit historical data or modify core equations unless synthetic truth recovery succeeds, the factor directions are predeclared and observed, all four cells have stable source hashes, and the result is independently reproduced with the same matched seeds.
